app.tagline: A desktop shell for the pi coding agent

noNode.title: Node.js is required
noNode.body: Pi Desktop needs Node.js ≥ {{min}} with npm. pi is installed via npm, so Node is a hard prerequisite.
noNode.detected: Detected Node.js v{{version}}, which is below the required v{{min}}.
noNode.notFound: Node.js was not found on your PATH.

noPi.title: Install pi
noPi.body: Pi Desktop is a GUI shell: the agent runtime lives in your own environment. Install pi with npm — the only supported install method:
noPi.hint: Your config, sessions and keys live in ~/.pi/agent/ and stay yours. Pi Desktop never upgrades pi without you asking.

nonNpm.title: Switch pi to the npm install
nonNpm.body: Found pi v{{version}} at {{path}}, but it was not installed via npm. The desktop app can only embed an npm-installed pi for the full experience.
nonNpm.lossless: Switching is lossless: your config, sessions and keys in ~/.pi/agent/ are shared by every install method. The old binary is left untouched — remove it yourself if you want.
nonNpm.shadowed: An npm-installed pi (v{{version}}) already exists, but {{binPath}} comes first on your PATH. Adjust your PATH or remove the old binary, then re-check.

outdated.title: pi is too old
outdated.body: Found pi v{{current}}, but Pi Desktop requires ≥ v{{min}}.

failed.title: Installation failed
failed.detail: The installer exited with an error. You can also run the command above in your terminal, then re-check.
